integrity: Theorem is accompanied by a complete direct Green-kernel proof and an executable independent variational rational checker. Numerical checks are not substituted for the universal argument. Priority is qualified against incomplete bibliographic coverage.
scientific_limitations: Real first-order periodic mean-zero Sobolev energy, unit arclength background, distinct sites and identical positive point masses; not unequal weights, nonuniform backgrounds, higher-order energy or other graphs. The equal-spacing polarization ingredient is prior work.
title: Sharp cubic-gap stability for optimally placed Sobolev mean constraints on a circle
